title: Akiyama Mizuki — Putting A Name To The Face〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: Putting A Name To The Face（2★）

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, see you later, Honami, Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: See you again, Emu, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, this should be far enough away.
In their minds, we're well on our way home.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But it seems like a shame to call things here.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is there anything you wanna get, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually, would you mind if I asked you two for a favor first...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want to thank Ms. Mochizuki somehow for inviting us out today and for everything she helps me with. Do you have any suggestions?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Is that what you meant by a favor?
Hmm... Flowers are the first thing that comes to mind for me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, there's this place where you can make a bouquet!
They have staff there to help, so anyone can do it♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, that's perfect!
And it totally goes with the bridal fair theme!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, it does...
Then, I think I'll do that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade worked really hard on that bouquet, so we've gotta witness the moment she gives it to Honami!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, Mizuki, let's start our operation!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Oh, should we give ourselves a name or something?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, we should...
We can be called...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The “Witnesses of Bouquet Giving”!!!
How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Yeah, I like it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, witnesses, move out♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Private Mizuki, our targets are on the move!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
They're crossing the intersection...
We gotta chase after them!
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
They look like they're having fun.
What do you think they're talking about?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope it's about the bridal fair.
Supermarket

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Private Emu, what are they up to now?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
They just grabbed some cucumbers!
I think they're gonna make a salad!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... This is starting to look like a normal grocery run.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Honami said that she's heading over to Kanade's house before she goes home, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. Which means Kanade's probably gonna give Honami the bouquet at her house.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we can't really follow them there...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: True. As much as I wanted to see how Honami would react when she received that bouquet...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I guess we have to suspend our operation...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That ended up falling apart...
But since we're here, wanna hang out for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Actually, I guess we sorta already have been...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Wanna go look at clothes and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go! Off to the shops♪
